shared_elements: horizontal bands or rows of linear pattern
justification: The main overlap is only generic: both surfaces use schematic relief/incised signs including round or oval motifs and horizontal linear bands or patterned rows. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a frontal anthropomorphic figure with head, torso-like features and central body markings, while B is organized as a panel of animal/abstract motifs and patterned bands without the same human-body scheme.
